{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Sivulliq''''' was a prototype [[RK-720 Light Freighter]] designed and manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] on [[Edic Bar]], [[Genarius]]. The ship was stolen from the manufacturing plant and was eventually recovered two months later by heroes in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="ITSC">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref> However, SoroSuub decided not to put the design into production and so gave the prototype back to the heroes who had rescued it.<ref name="BW">''[[Blown Away]]'' (as described in [https://web.archive.org/web/20021218152817/www.wizards.com/rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010927b_transmissions&c=swlfc Transmissions From the Living Force Campaign] on the [[Wikipedia:Internet Archive#Wayback machine|Way back machine]])</ref> In their haste, SoroSuub engineers failed to remove a prototype [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] from the freighter.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sivulliq'' was given as a unique prize to one of the roleplayers at the [[Gen Con Game Fair 2001]] [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] interactive ''[[Blown Away]]''. This was later described in an in-universe account in [[The Sivulliq Is Out There -- Somewhere|''The'' Sivulliq ''Is Out There -- Somewhere'']].
